thread:
Alex: Quick heads-up — qx3b-int4 bring-up results are in. Latency and cost look great, but we're seeing a ~6-8% drop on the deid longtail golden evaluation vs quant4b baseline. Opening this thread to coordinate a micro-golden refresh + labeling surge so we can isolate model vs quant artifact.

Mira: Can you paste one or two archetypal failing examples? Is it hallucination, truncation, or formatting loss?

Alex: Two representative cases below (redacted). Looks like entity masking breakdowns and some hallucinated filler where the model used to emit [REDACTED] properly.

Alex: ```
# sample (redacted):
prompt: "User: Please remove PII and summarize the support ticket."
baseline (quant4b): "[REDACTED] The issue is..."
qx3b-int4: "Customer John Doe reported... The issue is..."

# quick stats:
- sample set: 2,000 longtail deid cases
- fail rate baseline: 2.1%
- fail rate qx3b-int4: 8.7%
```

LabelOpsBot: Queue status: pending=124, avg_time_to_review=18h, active_labelers=42. Recommended surge capacity: +20 labelers for 48-72h for a ~2k micro-golden.

Sam: We can provision a 3-day surge of ~20 labelers from the pool; need Priya to confirm budget + priority. I'll also spin up a canary eval dashboard for the new micro-golden.

Priya: OK to allocate 15 labelers Fri-Sun and 10 Mon-Tue (night shifts optional). Budget approved for up to 60k labels over the next sprint. Please finalize sampling now so ops can create tasks.

Alex: Proposed sampling SQL for micro-golden (apply dedupe/fuzzy filter before creating tasks):
```sql
SELECT id, prompt, context FROM samplebank
WHERE is_deid = TRUE
  AND token_count > 256
  AND model_failure_flag = TRUE
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 2000;
```

Mira: We must dedupe against current golden and recent label runs. I ran a quick fingerprint check earlier; collision rate was low but non-zero.

Alex: I ran the dedupe check, output below: 
```bash
$ python tools/fingerprint_check.py --src samples.csv --gold goldset.csv --threshold 0.92
# output: collisions: 14/2000 (0.7%)
```
We'll drop collisions and replace with next-in-seed to keep the micro-golden size intact.

Jonah: Also FYI: there's a regression signal on RAG prompts with >2k context. Might be an int4 KV-cache edge with long ctx. CC @Eve (eng-runtime) to triage kernel differences.

Eve: We observed similar artifacts in profiling. We'll run an int4-kernel parity pass and a KV-cache consistency check. ETA 48 hours. If we find kernel-induced token corruption, we can push a micro-patch or route RAG requests to the quant4b variant as a fallback.

Sam: Action items so far:
- Alex: finalize the 2k sample set and push to /label-ops (today noon PT)
- Mira: run final dedupe + fuzzyhash sweep and hand off gold candidates (by EOD)
- Priya: confirm labeler roster and shifts (done)
- Eve: start int4 kernel parity checks (48h)
- Sam: create canary eval dashboard and canary traffic plan (2h)

Alex: Timeline we aim for: micro-golden labeled by EOW, canary eval run Mon morning, decision to roll or fallback Mon afternoon. If regressions persist, we fallback routing for deid/RAG to quant4b and continue kernel work.

Mira: One more ask — include synthetic paraphrases for 25% of the micro-golden (to cover phrasing variance). We should also tag each golden item with the failing symptom (hallucination/PII-leak/truncation) so we can correlate.

Alex: Good call. I'll seed 500 synthetic paraphrases using the paraphrase synth job and tag symptoms.

Priya: LabelOpsBot, please prioritize these tasks with label_project = "qx3b-int4-deid-microgolden" and set SLA to 24h.

LabelOpsBot: Done — project created, priority=high, SLA=24h, expected completion baseline 72h given current pool.

Jonah: Ping me if you want quick help designing the canary evaluation metrics — I can add per-symptom precision/recall and an auto-fail threshold.

Sam: I'll include per-symptom PR and a weighted quality delta metric. Will post the dashboard link when ready. :eyes: :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks all — I'll post the final sample CSV and link to the label job here once pushed. If anyone spots missing instrumentation or edge cases to include, speak up now.

Mira: I'll watch for the CSV and run the final fuzzyhash.

Eve: Starting kernel checks now, will update infra-telemetry channel with any anomalies.

Sam: Created label job draft and canary eval stub (internal link omitted).
